_comment: Gemini CLI command configuration template. Drop into .gemini/gemini_cli_config.json in your repo. Each entry under 'commands' is a named shell shortcut.

list_files.description: List all files and directories in the current directory.

_field_reference.command: Required. Shell command string. Multi-step ops should call a script in scripts/.
_field_reference.directory: Optional. Working directory relative to repo root. Omit for repo root.
